prose: A Lobste.rs community thread: a member working a long-standing issue with admin-suggested refactoring asked for a pair-coding partner, explicitly barring LLM contributions - 'just crude old style brain smashing'. A Rubyist volunteered for Friday, and the two arranged to pair on the feature.
highlights: Lobste.rs member seeks pair-coding partner for a refactor
Explicitly no-LLM: 'crude old style brain smashing'
Found a Ruby pairing partner for Friday
Community color; marginal AI relevance beyond the no-LLM stance
